set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Measure whether a public producer can actually emit a negative NodeSummary level, then repair the source boundary only if required. Current downstream wire/source checks already refuse; a permitted open-trait shape is not measured occurrence.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

FOLLOW-UP (T4) found while sealing StructuralCoverage (bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX).

NodeSummary.apply (align/source.scala ~304) does not check level. SourceView is an open trait, so a view may carry a negative-level node. Today this is caught only downstream: AlignWire.coverageOk refuses level < 0 inside CostBreakdown, and mappingsource.scala:215 has its own n.level < 0 check. StructuralCoverage therefore deliberately does not hold level >= 0 (source.scala doc); it holds only the count relation.

Link reached: permits. Reachability through the public producers (StorySourceView, InMemorySourceView) has not been measured.

Acceptance:
- Measure whether any public producer can emit level < 0.
- If one can, give NodeSummary a checked factory, or state the range in the SourceView contract and refuse it at view construction, with a failing witness first.
